entities.summary: The Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Center Stadium is a stadium situated in the sports center area of the Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Center in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It is used mainly for association football, athletics, rugby union, and rugby sevens.
